component.name: Hinkwise
component.summary: Plan your personal economy with the four-bucket model

description.p: Hinkwise is a local-first planner for personal finances, built around the four-bucket model: a buffer for money you need soon, a preserve-value bucket for the middle years, a growth bucket for the long run, and a small play bucket so the rest stays untouched.
It sizes each bucket against your own monthly expenses, counts housing and pension so you can see how much you are really worth, and expresses your position in years of freedom rather than in kronor.
Your data never leaves the machine. There is no network code, no account and no telemetry.
Initial skeleton: window, theme and bucket overview.
